image_description: A group of women in traditional folk dresses (dirndls) dancing around a tall white pole decorated with colorful ribbons (streamers) extending from the top. The scene takes place outdoors on a grassy field under a blue sky with clouds. A decorative wreath or floral arrangement sits at the very top of the pole.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pole is clearly visible, vertical, and extends significantly above the heads of the dancers, consistent with a maypole structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple colored ribbons are seen originating from the top and reaching down to the hands of the dancers.
